jobs.title: Full-Stack Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Growth Engineer

About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a Full-Stack Growth Engineer to build and maintain the product and systems that help more of the right people discover Future, convert into members, and reach their first moments of value.

You’ll work across web and backend surfaces that power acquisition, signup and access, onboarding and activation, and early engagement. You’ll ship experiments end to end, instrument funnels carefully, and partner closely with product, design, data, and marketing on a small, senior team.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between product judgment and system design, write production code, run trustworthy experiments, and turn learnings into durable product improvements — not one-off hacks.

What You’ll Own:

  • Acquisition and Conversion: Build and improve the web and product surfaces that introduce Future to prospective members and turn interest into signup. These include landing experiences, checkout and plan selection flows, and the instrumentation that shows where people drop off.
  • Access and Onboarding: Simplify signup, login, account creation, and first-session activation. Remove friction, clarify value on Day 1, and help new members connect with coaching and get started quickly.
  • Experimentation Systems: Design, ship, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across the funnel. Partner with data to define metrics, guardrails, and experiment hygiene so we learn fast without polluting the product.
  • Full-Stack Delivery: Implement features across frontend and backend — APIs, services, web UI, and the glue between growth surfaces and the core member product. Prefer clear ownership and fast iteration over brittle one-off paths.
  • Measurement and Insight: Instrument funnels, cohorts, and activation milestones. Use qualitative and quantitative signal to find leverage, prioritize work, and explain why experiments won or lost.
  • Reliability for Growth Paths: Keep high-traffic growth journeys fast, stable, and observable. Treat conversion-critical paths with the same engineering care as core product.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work tightly with product, design, data, and marketing. Translate growth hypotheses into shippable product work and bring engineering judgment into roadmap tradeoffs.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members or prospects.

Who You Are:

Experience and Background

  • You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer growth, acquisition, activation, or conversion surfaces.
  • You are strong full-stack: comfortable across modern web frontend and backend services, and able to ship an experiment from UI through API and data without waiting on another team for every layer.
  • You have run growth experiments in production — A/B tests, funnel instrumentation, and iteration based on measured outcomes, not vibes alone.
  • You understand customer journeys: segments, touchpoints, dropoff analysis, and how product changes move activation and retention metrics.
  • You can debug across web UI, networking, backend services, analytics pipelines, and CI.
  • You have partnered with product, design, and data (or marketing) to take ambiguous growth problems from hypothesis to shipped learning.
  • You write clear, maintainable code and care about experiment integrity, observability, and long-term operability — not just shipping the next test.
  • You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and know how to verify their output.

Domain Passion

You care about health, fitness, and helping people start — and stick with — better habits. You’re motivated by the craft of turning curiosity into membership and first value.

Working Style

  • You bias to action, then measure. You ship small, learn, and compound.
  • You raise concerns early and bring possible solutions when experiments or funnels look wrong.
  • You share context, invite feedback, and keep partners aligned on metrics and tradeoffs.
  • You take ownership from discovery through production support on the paths you ship.
  • You balance growth urgency with product quality and member trust.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a consumer subscription, marketplace, or membership product where acquisition and activation were core to the business.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and other laws and regulations that apply to health products and services.
  • Experience with paid acquisition landing systems, attribution, SEO/organic surfaces, lifecycle messaging, or referral loops.
  • Experience building or evolving experimentation platforms, feature flags, or analytics instrumentation at scale.
  • Experience with fitness, health, coaching, or other personalized consumer products.
  • Prior work on expert tooling, internal operator workflows, or coach-facing surfaces that support member outcomes.

Compensation, Benefits & Life at Future:

  • Salary range: $200,000 - 230,000 / year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
  • Health coverage: All employees have access to comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance + tax savings accounts
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free!
  • Health, Wellness & Development: Health and fitness monthly stipend contributes to our employees’ overall wellbeing, with access to a mental health platform, reimbursement for medical travel, and an annual learning & development stipend.
  • Remote First: Employment eligible to employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required.
  • Join a diverse, passionate & driven team of all backgrounds.

Life at Future

Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.
Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft.
Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free.

jobs.title: Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Women's Health and Organ Health)
jobs.description:
Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Women's Health and Organ Health)

Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team of Bioinformatics Scientists in our Women's Health and Organ Health research organization. You will oversee the scientific planning and execution of research and assay-development of diagnostic projects, and you will be responsible for creating production-ready pipeline components. You will manage your team and its professional growth, the research strategy behind new product development, and the handoff of research work into production.

The role calls for deep experience in algorithm and assay development, NGS data processing across multiple modalities, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product research and development in a regulated (CLIA) setting. You will evaluate new technologies and NGS assays, implement methods to optimize performance, and help define the product profile from a bioinformatics perspective, with input from R&D, Product, and Laboratory Directors.

Primary Responsibilities:

Team Leadership and Development: Lead and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and the standard the team holds itself to.

Research Strategy: Own the research strategy behind new product development, from scoping through execution, working with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order.

Assay Science: Lead bioinformatics analysis for assay development and optimization, and troubleshoot experiments alongside laboratory scientists. This spans multi-omic approaches including methylation and fragmentomics and other cell-free DNA (cfDNA) derived features. It also spans short-read and long-read sequencing and both hybrid-capture and amplicon target enrichment.

Study Design and Data Quality: Partner with laboratory teams on study design at the research and feasibility stage, covering new technology assessment, optimization, and performance determination. Make sure the resulting data holds up before anyone builds on it.

Analysis Method Improvement: Advise and prototype improvements to analysis pipelines, including variant detection, quality control, and modality-specific processing: methylation calling, fragment-size and end-motif analysis, error suppression for deep targeted panels, and structural-variant calling.

Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and containerization. Automate the routine parts of research data management, pipeline execution, and reporting so the team's time goes to science.

Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off. We do not screen for prior experience with these tools, and many strong candidates come from environments where they were restricted; we provide the tooling and the ramp time.

Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company.

What success looks like after a year:

  • The team has a research roadmap you own, and progress against it is visible outside the team.
  • You independently advise and guide research strategies in cross functional settings.
  • New analysis methods from your team are implemented within production code and demonstrate expected performance on benchmark studies..
  • You and team members become trusted experts that other functions direct their hard questions to, and can independently support decision making.
  • AI agent-assisted work is normal on the team, with a standard for it that you set.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Biostatistics, or a related field. (An M.S. with equivalent experience considered).
  • 7+ years in bioinformatics, including 3+ years leading scientists and working across functions.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a team that took scientific research into real clinical use, not only to a result.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or scientifically guiding diagnostic sequencing assays.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

What we are screening for

  • Deep expertise in next-generation sequencing analysis: hybrid-capture or amplicon-based target enrichment designs, sequencing quality control, secondary analysis, and variant calling.
  • Experience with cell-free DNA sequencing and other omics data, especially in a diagnostics setting. Preferred to have some exposure to multiomics types : methylation, fragmentomics, or related cfDNA signals.
  • Working knowledge of how a diagnostic product moves through development in a regulated, accredited setting, including the practices and standards that apply.
  • Strong Python, programming, and data analysis skills.
  • Fluency in exploratory data analysis and visualization on complex data sets, and the ability to translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Understanding of sequencing workflows from sample extraction through the instrument, deep enough to tell a biology problem from an analysis problem.
  • A demonstrated record of assessing a new platform, assay chemistry or method against established benchmarks..
  • Clear communication of technical detail to people who do not share your background.
  • The ability to run several objectives and timelines at once without close supervision.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Long-read sequencing (PacBio HiFi, Oxford Nanopore) in addition to short-read (Illumina).
  • R, shell scripting, or Java.
  • Cloud computing (AWS, GCP) and workflow orchestration (Snakemake, WDL, Nextflow, Cromwell).
  • Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) for reproducible, production-grade analyses.
  • A record of conference presentations or peer-reviewed publication.
  • A desire to work in a fast-paced environment where a small team has high impact.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$166,600—$202,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

Teamlead Content Strategist (m/w/d)

ÜBER NEOLYMP

NEOLYMP ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir erfolgreich über Amazon sowie unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Als schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Marke arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Kompetenzen intern aufzubauen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs sowie der Entwicklung moderner, KI-gestützter Creative-Prozesse.

Aufgaben

WARUM DIESE ROLLE

  • Du bestimmst, was gebaut wird: Angles, Hooks, Konzepte, Funnel-Logik – du entscheidest, welche Creatives entstehen und warum. Das Grafikteam setzt um, was du konzipierst.
  • Direkter Hebel auf Umsatz: Deine Konzepte laufen auf Meta und weiteren Paid-Kanälen, auf Landingpages und im Shop. Was du testest, siehst du in ROAS, CTR und Conversion Rate – nicht in Quartalsberichten.
  • Führung mit Substanz: Du leitest ein Grafikteam, das Video und Statics in-house produziert, und gestaltest, wie dieses Team arbeitet, wächst und besser wird.
  • Kein Agentur-Ping-Pong: Research, Konzept, Briefing, Produktion, Test, Iteration – die gesamte Kette liegt bei uns im Haus. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Performance, Shopify-Entwicklung und Creator-Management.
  • Eine Marke, die noch Spielraum hat: Wir sind groß genug für echte Budgets und klein genug, dass deine Handschrift Sichtbar wird.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Strategie & Konzeption

  • Du entwickelst die Content-Strategie für unsere Performance-Kanäle (insbesondere Meta) und unseren Onlineshop – von der übergeordneten Creative-Roadmap bis zum einzelnen Ad-Konzept.
  • Du konzipierst Angles, Hooks und Formate auf Basis von Zielgruppen-Insights, Awareness-Stufen und Wettbewerbsanalysen und baust daraus eine systematische Testing-Pipeline.
  • Du entwickelst und optimierst Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten konzeptionell – Aufbau, Argumentation,Einwandbehandlung – gemeinsam mit unserem Shopify Manager.
  • Du setzt die komplette content-gesteuerte Seite unserer Sales-Events auf: Dramaturgie, Creative-Konzepte, Landingpages, Timing über alle Kanäle hinweg.

Research & Positionierung

  • Du führst Produkt- und Zielgruppen-Research durch: Wer kauft, warum, mit welchen Einwänden – und wie sprechen wir diese Menschen an?
  • Du entwickelst die Positionierung unserer Produkte und entscheidest, an wen wir welches Produkt mit welchem Angle richten.
  • Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerb und Plattform-Trends und übersetzt sie in konkrete Content-Hypothesen.

Teamführung & Briefing

  • Du führst unser Grafikteam fachlich und disziplinarisch, setzt Prioritäten, gibst klares Feedback und entwickelst die Menschen in deinem Team weiter.
  • Du schreibst präzise Creative-Briefings – mit Zielgruppe, Angle, Hook, Referenzen und Erfolgskriterien – und sorgst für eine Produktion, die schnell, strukturiert und qualitativ hochwertig läuft.
  • Du koordinierst mit Creator-Management und Shooting-Planung, welcher Content produziert werden muss, damit deine Konzepte umsetzbar sind.

Analyse & Iteration

  • Du analysierst die Performance von Creatives und Landingpages gemeinsam mit dem Performance-Team und leitest daraus Learnings, Iterationen und neue Konzepte ab.
  • Du baust eine Wissensbasis auf: Was funktioniert bei welcher Zielgruppe, welche Hooks tragen, welche Formate skalieren.

Qualifikation

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Scaling von Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta (und idealerweise TikTok, Google oder YouTube) – du hast Creatives konzipiert, die mit relevantem Budget profitabel gelaufen sind, und kannst darüber konkret sprechen.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein Team oder Kreativschaffende geführt, kennst den Unterschied zwischen Anweisung und Entwicklung und weißt, wie man ein Team gleichzeitig fordert und hält.
  • Tiefes Verständnis für Direct-Response-Prinzipien, Awareness-Stufen, Hook-Mechaniken und Funnel-Psychologie – du kannst erklären, warum ein Creative funktioniert, nicht nur dass es funktioniert.
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Landingpages, Funnel-Seiten oder Sales-Events im E-Commerce / D2C.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

  • Starke Research-Kompetenz: Du arbeitest mit Kundeninterviews, Reviews, Umfragen, Wettbewerbs- und Ad-Library- Analysen und ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse.
  • Datenkompetenz: Du liest ROAS, CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CPA und Conversion Rate sicher und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.
  • Exzellente Briefing- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit – schriftlich wie mündlich, mit Designer:innen genauso wie mit Performance-Marketern.
  • Ein Blick für Gestaltung: Du musst nicht selbst schneiden, aber du erkennst, ob ein Creative dein Konzept trifft.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung – du wartest nicht auf Vorgaben, du machst Vorschläge.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung im Fitness-, Sport- oder Health-Bereich.
  • Erfahrung mit UGC- und Creator-Content in der Performance-Produktion.
  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in Research, Ideation oder Creative-Produktion.
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo oder Amazon-Marketing.
  • Wir suchen für diese Rolle bewusst ein starkes Profil – jemanden, der schon unter Beweis gestellt hat, was hier erwartet wird. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns auf dich.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial (f/m/d)

About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling Sales, Customer Success and Marketing with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial, you make sure every seat in Sales, Customer Success and Marketing goes to someone exceptional. You report to Fritz Cramer, Co-CEO, and work closely with our VP Sales, Head of SC Sales, Head of Customer Success and Marketing Lead. That means real ownership: you shape how Cosuno hires, not just who.

What you will achieve in your first 12 months

  • You hire 25 people across Account Executives, Customer Success and Inside Sales Managers, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • You turn every role into a clear scorecard and give hiring managers structured interviews they actually use.

  • You relaunch our referral programme and turn our team into our best talent scouts.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.


What the job really looks like

  • A large part of your week is active sourcing and candidate conversations. If you prefer managing agencies, this role is not for you.

  • You run several commercial processes in parallel, with ambitious hiring managers who want great people fast.

  • There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

  • You push back when a profile or a decision is not right. We want you to.


What you bring

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, hiring SDRs and Account Executives.

  • A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

  • Proven sourcing skills: you have filled roles through direct outreach and can show what worked.

  • Structured assessment: you run scorecard-based interviews and can tell real sales talent from a good pitch.

  • Strong closing skills: you win top candidates against competing offers and counteroffers.

  • Strong stakeholder management: you advise hiring managers and challenge them when it matters.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

  • You use AI tools and automation in sourcing and outreach.

  • Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.


What we offer

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

  • AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay and Lusha, and you have a budget to test new tools.

  • Learning budget for your professional development.

  • Time off: 25-30 vacation days per year.

  • Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

  • A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.


Our hiring process (max. 3 weeks)

  1. Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

  2. Career deep-dive with Fritz (Co-CEO) 30 minutes, video.

  3. Live case study: together with two of our hiring managers (Basti, Kornelius or Caspar), you work through a sourcing case for a fictional SDR role, 60 minutes, preferably in our Berlin office.

  4. References: with your consent only, we speak with 2–3 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

  5. Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 3 weeks.


Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead


We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

ennovationHUB is an expanding international e-commerce group specialising in the home & living sector, with furniture at the core of our offering. Through our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers throughout the UK, North America, the EU, and APAC.

As we work towards €160m+ in annual revenue by 2027, we are seeking a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us as soon as possible. You will lead Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, taking direct responsibility for revenue growth, advertising efficiency, and profitability.

About the opportunity:

You will be part of an international business operating multiple e-commerce brands, with substantial advertising investment across several markets. Working at this scale means your decisions will directly influence revenue and commercial results.

Google Ads already plays a significant role in our growth. We are looking for someone who enjoys navigating international e-commerce, working with large datasets, and uncovering opportunities that deliver measurable improvements.

Working alongside our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists, you will use analysis, experimentation, and hands-on optimisation to develop this established channel further. Your focus will be on maintaining strong current performance while supporting efficient growth over time.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Own Google Ads performance across international markets for one of our e-commerce brands

  • Run and optimise Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign formats

  • Monitor and improve core performance measures, including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability

  • Turn campaign insights into clear recommendations and practical next steps

  • Contribute to budget allocation, forecasting, and performance reporting

The impact you can make:

Our Google Ads campaigns already generate results. You will build on that foundation by uncovering further opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling successful approaches.

In a competitive e-commerce environment, even small improvements can make a significant commercial difference. You will connect campaign decisions to business outcomes and remain accountable for their impact.

You will collaborate with experienced colleagues who work quickly and place a high value on execution. We welcome independent judgment, evidence-based decisions, and constructive questions about existing approaches. You will have the trust to make decisions and directly support the company’s growth.


In-house e-commerce experience is a requirement for this position. Candidates whose Google Ads experience is primarily gained through agencies, consultancy, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for someone who has owned performance within an e-commerce company, with results evaluated through revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and sustained growth.

You should understand how campaign performance connects to wider commercial goals and be comfortable taking responsibility for both decision-making and implementation.

What you will bring:

  • A minimum of 2 years of practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns

  • A proven record of managing Google Ads within an e-commerce business, with direct accountability for results and profitability

  • Extensive practical knowledge of Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns

Your working style:

You bring senior-level judgment while staying actively involved in campaign execution and performance. You draw clear conclusions from data and translate those findings into practical action.

You want to understand what drives results and regularly look for ways to improve them. You can move comfortably between longer-term planning and daily optimisation while keeping business growth and commercial outcomes in focus.

You enjoy developing and scaling campaigns, accepting responsibility for their performance, and helping an established channel continue to grow.

International collaboration and travel:

Our team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. As the company grows, we are continuing to invest in our team presence.

The role includes travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations. These visits provide time for joint planning, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions.

Most work takes place remotely, complemented by regular opportunities to collaborate and plan together in person as the business scales.

Senior Account Executive, DACH (German-speaking, Hamburg)

Our mission and why it matters

We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer.

Human risk remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities and traditional awareness training is not enough. We take a different approach by combining AI-driven personalization, real threat detection, and behavioral science to actively protect people and organizations.

We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them.

Why this role matters

The DACH region is currently our largest growth market in EMEA, generating an incredible amount of pipeline. With a highly certified product and an exceptional service that customers genuinely love, we have laid a strong foundation. We are now looking for a highly self-motivated Senior Account Executive who excels at taking those enterprise opportunities, multi-threading to economic buyers, and guiding them successfully through complex procurement cycles. You will be joining a team that has already proven it can support companies in seeing the value of the service, making this a prime opportunity to drive significant revenue rather than a speculative territory. Crucially, as our business results grow, you will be instrumental in helping us lay the groundwork for our future local hub in the Hamburg area.

What you’ll own and drive

You will take full ownership of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH market, expertly guiding deals from initial pipeline through complex procurement to closed-won. Driving multi-threaded deals is second nature to you, as you reach economic buyers early and confidently hold the line on price objections. You will lead POC-led selling initiatives with real, concrete exit criteria to ensure successful outcomes, all while partnering closely with an SDR to prioritize opportunities and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene with customer-owned next steps.

What success looks like

• In your first 3 months you'll be fully onboarded, deeply understand our qualification framework, and have a few opportunities moving past the initial stages with real, dated next steps.

• By month 6, you'll operate independently, managing an active pipeline, progressing opportunities consistently to late stage pipeline, and building your new business ARR towards quota.

What makes you thrive here

You have native-level or full business proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English, and several years of experience as a closing AE in B2B SaaS. Specifically, you have a proven track record of taking deals through procurement in fast-paced software or licensing sales, rather than just generating them. You bring a strong commercial backbone and comfort with multi-threading to an economic buyer before a proposal ever goes out. Above all, you have a team-first mindset with forecast honesty—you own your pipeline and embrace a collaborative, winning-together attitude.

You are a true self-starter who is phenomenal at what you currently do, taking pride in driving significant impact as a senior individual contributor.

To support our near-future vision of opening a physical hub in Germany, we are looking for candidates who are ideally already based in the wider Hamburg region.

Bonus points if you also bring experience with 3 to 6 month enterprise buying cycles and committees, or prior exposure to regulated DACH verticals like manufacturing, healthcare, or financial services. A background in cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance software is highly valued, as is a habit of leveraging technology creatively in your daily workflow.

Who you’ll work with

You will be a key part of our EMEA Sales Team, reporting to our EMEA Head of Sales. This DACH-focused role is working in a highly supportive AE group focusing on the EMEA market. We are committed to a collaborative culture but you will also be given independence to run your opportunities. You will find a team that asks for something back on every concession, owns their forecast misses honestly, and truly lives by a team-first standard that shows up in how we actually operate, rather than just as an aspiration on a slide.

What you can expect from us

• Compensation: Monthly fixed base salary of € 6000 - € 7000 depending on your experience (plus a 50/50 base and commission model featuring accelerated earnings for the first 12 months). You may notice varying salary ranges for roles with similar titles across Hoxhunt; this is because each range is grounded in our role leveling and reflects the seniority, scope, and impact expectations required for that specific role and team, and we operate with a low hierarchy.

• Working ways: You will start by working remotely from the Hamburg region. However, as we are planning to build a hub in Hamburg in the near future, this will eventually transform into a hybrid role. You will enjoy a flexible work setting with opportunities to travel and connect with the broader team.

• High performance meets high humanity: We bring an incredibly driven, high-impact energy to our work, but we leave our egos at the door. You will be surrounded by wildly talented, dedicated colleagues in an environment built on extreme kindness, support, and psychological safety.

• Authentic trust & autonomy: We hire great people and trust them to do great work. You will find a culture free of micromanagement, giving you the autonomy to take real ownership, drive impact, and shape things early on.

• A product you can be proud of: It is incredibly rare in cybersecurity to build a multi-award-winning product that end-users genuinely love. You will join a fast-paced, technically sophisticated team making a real, measurable impact against cybercrime, backed by strong financial stability and growth.

• The perks that matter: Alongside this amazing community, you will enjoy extensive healthcare with other benefits tailored for our team in Germany.

To ensure your personal data is handled securely and in compliance with GDPR, we only accept applications submitted through our application form. We cannot process applications sent via other channels, such as email or LinkedIn messages.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Interview with Talent Acquisition (remote, 30 min)

  2. Interview with EMEA Head of Sales (remote, 45 min)

  3. Take-home assignment and panel (on-site in Helsinki, 90 min)

  4. Reference checks and offer

About Hoxhunt

Hoxhunt was founded in 2016 by four visionaries. Today we are a global team of +300 amazing Hoxhunters advancing a truly AI-native category leader in human risk management, with key hubs in the United States, the United Kingdom, Singapore, and Finland. We are proud to be an award-winning, fast-growing software company, recognized by G2 and Gartner, named to TIME Magazine's list of the World's Top EdTech Companies, and featured for our innovation in major publications like Fast Company, TechCrunch, Forbes, and Inc.

As a multi-product company, Hoxhunt goes beyond traditional security awareness. We don't just educate employees through frequent, personalized, and behavior-changing cybersecurity training - we also actively build real threat intelligence and response tools that protect organizations against malicious cyberattacks every single day.

Be among the first to know about our open positions. Drop your details in our Talent Community, and we will reach out when there is a match!

Graduate Product Manager

Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We're reinventing how trading and investing work by building exceptional products people love.

We move fast, set a high bar, and expect excellence from everyone on the team.

The role

We're looking for exceptional graduates to join Trading 212 as Graduate Product Managers. You'll help shape products that make investing simpler and more accessible, turning complex problems into intuitive experiences.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one. You'll work with engineers, designers and teams across the business to understand client needs, decide what matters most, and take ideas from problem to launch. You'll be expected to question assumptions, get into the details and measure whether what we build actually makes things better.

This is a highly demanding role for exceptionally ambitious people who want to accelerate their career growth. It requires sustained effort, discipline and a commitment to excellence. You'll face difficult problems, high expectations and a steep learning curve.

No prior work experience is required. We're looking for exceptional ability, sound judgment and the drive to turn ideas into results.

  • Turn ambiguous problems into clear proposals, user journeys and product requirements.

  • Work closely with designers and engineers to build simple, reliable and intuitive solutions.

  • Prioritise improvements by weighing client value, business impact, effort and risk.

  • Define success metrics, analyse results and design experiments that help us make better decisions.

  • Take ownership of features from discovery through launch and iteration, with support from senior colleagues.

  • Spot confusing interactions, unnecessary steps and overlooked details, and drive improvements.

  • Use LLMs and prototyping tools to explore ideas, test assumptions and accelerate your work, checking the quality of their output.

What you need to have

  • Outstanding academic performance. An achieved First-Class degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, Finance or another highly quantitative subject from a top university, placing you in the top 10% of your cohort.

  • Exceptional problem-solving ability. You can bring structure to ambiguous problems, identify root causes and develop simple, practical solutions. You reason from first principles, challenge assumptions and test your conclusions against evidence.

  • Uncompromising work ethic. You set demanding standards for yourself and are willing to put in exceptional, sustained effort to meet them. You're ambitious about your growth, embrace difficult challenges and take responsibility for improving quickly. You persevere, follow through on commitments and take pride in delivering excellent work.

  • A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes from start to finish. You act without waiting to be asked, anticipate obstacles, raise issues early and stay accountable until the problem is resolved.

  • Exceptional analytical reasoning. You work confidently with numbers, distinguish signal from noise and reach defensible conclusions from incomplete information.

  • Strong product judgment. You can explain what makes a product excellent, identify where an experience falls short and propose a simpler solution with clear trade-offs.

  • Evidence of exceptional initiative. You've taken a demanding idea beyond the brief and produced something tangible through an academic, personal or extracurricular project. You can explain your decisions, what you learned and what you would improve.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex problem into a concise, structured explanation and defend your recommendation under questioning.

  • Technical fluency. You understand how software products work, can use SQL to answer questions from data, and can build a simple prototype to communicate or test an idea.

  • Proficient, critical use of LLMs. You use them effectively for research, analysis and prototyping, recognise their limitations and independently verify important outputs.

  • Fast learning and intellectual honesty. You get up to speed quickly, seek demanding feedback and change your mind when the evidence warrants it.

  • A strong interest in investing and financial products. You're curious about how they work and how to make them easier for people to understand and use.

  • Full-time availability and willingness to work in-office.

Nice to have

  • Distinction in a highly competitive academic competition, Olympiad, hackathon or research award.

  • A self-directed app, tool or other project that people have chosen to use, with evidence of how you improved it from feedback.

  • Strong foundations in statistics, probability and experimental design.

  • Ability to code in Python or JavaScript, or create interactive prototypes in Figma.

  • A thoughtful understanding of investing products and the trade-offs between simplicity, functionality and client protection.

What we offer

  • The chance to help shape products used by millions of investors to build wealth.

  • The opportunity for exceptionally fast career growth through demanding challenges, real responsibility and direct feedback, with progression driven by your performance and impact.

  • Real ownership, with direct feedback from experienced product, design and engineering colleagues.

  • Smart, ambitious, high-performing colleagues who share a common goal.

  • An environment where nothing is set in stone and good ideas win.

  • Appreciation for your talent and ideas.

  • A highly competitive package, including annual bonuses.

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Lab & Protein Data
jobs.description:
Data Scientist, Lab & Protein Data

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

You'll build out the data science layer of Adaptyv's foundry — the work that turns tens of thousands of raw, messy experimental readouts into clean, trustworthy, structured data that our customers, our models, and our own scientists can rely on. Binding (BLI/SPR), developability, biophysical, and functional assays all produce data at scale; your job is to make that data correct, comparable, and useful.

This sits at the intersection of three things: data quality (is this number real, or an artifact?), bioinformatics (linking experimental results back to sequence, structure, and protein design), and dataset building (turning foundry output into the kind of high-quality, benchmarkable data that frontier AI labs actually want). You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the lab scientists who run the assays, the software team who own the pipelines, and the customers who train models on what we produce. This is a hands-on build role, not a management one.

What You'll Do

  • Own the scientific logic of data quality across the foundry: define what "good data" looks like for each assay type — expected signal ranges, control thresholds, failure modes, edge cases — and turn it into automated checks.

  • Build anomaly detection and QC models that catch bad data the eye would miss: assay drift, instrument variability, plate effects, false passes and false fails — and distinguish real signal from noise statistically.

  • Work with the software and ML teams to specify, review, and improve the automated data pipelines that process instrument outputs, feeding back precise requirements for what to flag, auto-reject, or route to human review.

  • Connect experimental results back to the protein side — sequence, structure, and design — so wet-lab data and computational models reinforce each other.

  • Turn foundry output into structured, documented, benchmark-grade datasets that are a genuine asset for our customers and for training and evaluating protein-design models.

  • Apply real statistical rigor to multi-condition data at scale — thousands of samples across hundreds of simultaneous experiments — and make the results interpretable and comparable across runs.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong data science / bioinformatics background — you're fluent in Python (pandas, numpy, the scientific stack) and comfortable owning messy, real-world experimental data end to end.

  • Genuine biology grounding — you understand proteins, assays, and sequence/structure/function well enough to know what the data means, not just how to process it. You don't need to be a bench scientist, but you can't be biology-blind.

  • Statistical maturity — process control, anomaly detection, handling variability and batch effects; you can tell drift from noise and defend the call.

  • Prolific builder with the receipts to prove it. You've shipped a lot — pipelines, tools, models, datasets — and can point to concrete things you built end to end and put into real use, not prototypes that died in a notebook. You move fast, systematize what works, and have no patience for babysitting a fixed dashboard.

  • AI-native builder. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce.

  • Interdisciplinary by instinct. You're energized working across the lab bench, software, and ML, and you treat automation and data infrastructure as part of your job.

  • Bonus: experience with protein/sequence-structure data (bioinformatics tooling, structural data), ML on experimental data, or building datasets for model training and benchmarking.

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP

Over de functie

Als HSE Specialist speel je een belangrijke rol in het veilig voorbereiden van een nieuwe chemische procesinstallatie op ingebruikname. Je werkt nauw samen met engineers, projectteams, contractors en toekomstige operations collega's om de processen, systemen en veiligheidsmaatregelen te ontwikkelen die nodig zijn voor een veilige opstart en bedrijfsvoering van DSL-01.

DSL-01 bevindt zich in de overgang van projectuitvoering naar operationele gereedheid. Om een veilige opstart en succesvolle lange termijn exploitatie mogelijk te maken, moeten alle benodigde QHSES-processen, procedures, systemen en tools worden ontwikkeld, geïmplementeerd en geborgd binnen de organisatie. In deze functie ondersteun je de QHSES Manager bij het realiseren van deze ambitie en draag je bij aan naleving van wet- en regelgeving, vergunningseisen, ISO-normen en interne bedrijfsstandaarden. Neemt bij afwezigheid van de QHSES Manager aangewezen QHSES-taken over en ziet toe op de naleving van veiligheidsvoorschriften, procedures en wettelijke verplichtingen om een veilige werkomgeving te waarborgen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • QHSES-managementsysteem & compliance: Ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling, implementatie en continue verbetering van het DSL-01 Integrated Management System en bijdragen aan naleving van bedrijfsstandaarden, wet- en regelgeving en best practices binnen de industrie.

  • Vergunningen & wettelijke naleving: Ondersteunen bij milieuvergunningen, vergunningswijzigingen, compliance-monitoring en het beheer van wettelijke registers, waaronder REACH-gerelateerde verplichtingen.

  • Risicomanagement & assurance: Ondersteunen bij proces- en veiligheidsrisicoanalyses, zoals HAZID-, HAZOP- en RI&E-trajecten, het beheren van risicoregisters en het ondersteunen van audits, inspecties en incidentonderzoeken om risico's binnen een industriële procesomgeving te beheersen.

Jouw profiel

We zijn een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt een goed begrip van arbeidsveiligheidswetgeving, risicomanagement en compliance vereisten.

  • Je hebt ervaring met ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 en/of Seveso/BRZO-gerelateerde kaders.

  • Je bent bekend met risicogestuurd werken en continu verbeteren.

  • Je hebt ervaring met RI&E-processen en risicoregisters.

  • Ervaring met ISO-certificeringstrajecten en externe audits.

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst (Finance)
jobs.description:
Operations Analyst (Finance)

Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote in Latin America.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Analyst (Finance) to join Able’s growing Operations function and work closely with our Head of Finance. This is a hands-on role with two connected areas of ownership: finance execution and business insights. You’ll help keep the financial side of the business running reliably, from payroll and expenses to monthly close support, while also building the reporting and dashboards leadership needs to make better decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both getting the numbers right and figuring out what the numbers are telling us. You’ll have the opportunity to build processes, improve systems, and establish reporting capabilities that don’t exist today.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Finance Operations

  • Own payroll execution across LATAM and US systems, including contractor payments and payroll reconciliation.
  • Manage employee expenses, corporate cards, receipts, approvals, and reimbursements.
  • Support the monthly close process through journal entries, reconciliations, invoice tracking, and accounts receivable follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate, clean, and reconciled financial data across relevant systems.
  • Partner with the Head of Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and ad hoc financial analysis.
  • Identify discrepancies and investigate issues until the underlying cause is understood and resolved.

Data & Business Insights

  • Build and maintain Able’s leadership dashboard, covering key business metrics such as revenue, pipeline, retainer health, utilization, and cash.
  • Establish recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting for the leadership team.
  • Define and document business metrics so teams are working from consistent definitions and data.
  • Provide ad hoc analysis to support strategic and operational decisions.
  • Monitor data quality across systems such as HubSpot or Attio, Deel, and Greenhouse, and coordinate resolution of issues when they arise.
  • Turn fragmented data into clear, actionable insights for leadership and other stakeholders.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–6 years of experience in finance operations, financial analysis, business operations, or a related analytical role, ideally within a growing company.
  • Hands-on experience with payroll, expense management, and monthly financial close processes.
  • Strong analytical skills and advanced spreadsheet proficiency.
  • Experience working with SQL and/or business intelligence tools such as Metabase, Looker Studio, or similar.
  • Experience building dashboards, reports, or analyses for leadership audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high level of comfort working with financial data.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Deel, Justworks, HubSpot, Attio, Greenhouse, or comparable systems.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and confidently with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership and the ability to manage work independently in a growing, evolving environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting both US and LATAM payroll or finance operations.
  • Experience working in a startup, services business, or other lean operating environment.
  • Experience establishing reporting processes or analytics capabilities from scratch.
  • Experience with financial planning, forecasting, or budgeting.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar as part of your day-to-day work.

What Success Looks Like

We’re looking for someone who brings more than technical skills. The right person for this role is:

  • AI-fluent. You already use AI tools in your day-to-day work to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks, draft materials, and work more efficiently.
  • A builder. You’re comfortable creating processes and systems where there isn’t a playbook yet. You’d rather ship a useful first version and improve it than wait for perfection.
  • Detail-oriented. You understand that financial operations require precision. When the numbers don’t tie, you want to know why.
  • A clear communicator. You surface problems early, ask questions when something is unclear, and communicate what you know — and what you don’t.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Able is growing and evolving quickly. You’ll help shape the processes and systems you’ll eventually own.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote in Latin America. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement.

As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.
  • Payments made in USD.
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.
  • Wellness + Remote Stipend
  • AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

Full-Time LATAM

Account Director, Digital Native Enterprise

jobs.title: Customer Journey Manager Automotive (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Customer Journey Manager Automotive (m/w/d)

Über die Bovensiepen Group

Was 1965 in Kaufbeuren als Vision von Burkard Bovensiepen begann, ist heute ein international anerkanntes Familienunternehmen mit unverwechselbarer DNA. Seit Jahren wird das Familienunternehmen von seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian geführt und steht für automobile Meisterwerke, handwerkliche Exzellenz und Perfektion in jedem Detail. Was hier entsteht, entsteht mit Hingabe, Präzision und höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Mit dem Übergang der ALPINA Markenrechte an BMW beginnt jetzt für die Gruppe ein neues Kapitel. Die automobile Leidenschaft wird unter der eigenständigen Marke Bovensiepen mit neuer Ausrichtung weitergeführt. Sechs Sparten bilden dabei das Rückgrat der Unternehmensgruppe, die Transformation als Chance versteht.

Für den Ausbau unseres Gebrauchtwagengeschäfts suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und handelnde Führungspersönlichkeit.

Ihre Rolle – Kundenerlebnis, Auftrag und Weiterentwicklung in einer Hand

Sie verantworten das Kundenerlebnis für zwei Fahrzeugwelten: unsere Bovensiepen-Neufahrzeuge, die in unserer Manufaktur in Buchloe nach Kundenwunsch entstehen, und unsere Certified Cars, geprüfte und aufbereitete Premium-Gebrauchtfahrzeuge.

Ab der ersten Anfrage begleiten Sie den Kunden Hand in Hand mit unseren Verkaufsberatern und Handelspartnern: Der Vertrieb führt das Verkaufsgespräch, Sie machen den gesamten Weg bis zur Übergabe und die Zeit danach zu einem Erlebnis. Ihre Kunden erwarten, dass jedes Detail sitzt und schätzen jede Idee, die ihr Fahrzeug noch persönlicher macht.

Diese Rolle gibt es bei uns in dieser Form zum ersten Mal. Sie übernehmen keinen fertigen Prozess, Sie gestalten ihn: Welche Momente begeistern unsere Kunden? Wie sieht eine Übergabe aus, von der sie noch Jahre später erzählen? Wann ist der richtige Zeitpunkt für die passende Sonderausstattung? Ihre Antworten setzen Sie selbst um. 50 Meter neben Ihrem Schreibtisch entstehen die Fahrzeuge, die Sie betreuen.

Aufgaben

  • Konfiguration und Individualisierung: Sie beraten Kunden gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zu Ausstattung, Materialien, Lackfarben und Interieur und übersetzen ihre Wünsche in verbindliche Fertigungs- und Aufbereitungsaufträge.

  • Zusatzgeschäft mit Fingerspitzengefühl: Sie bieten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Sonderausstattung und Zusatzleistungen rund um Pflege und Service an, stets beratend, niemals drängend.

  • Auftragssteuerung: Sie verfolgen Termine, klären Detailfragen direkt mit Manufaktur, Werkstatt, Einkauf und Logistik und informieren den Kunden proaktiv über jeden Meilenstein. Damit sind Sie die zentrale Schnittstelle zu unseren Kunden.

  • Übergabe als Höhepunkt: Sie planen und gestalten die Fahrzeugübergabe in Buchloe, beim Handelspartner oder beim Kunden, nicht als Ende des Prozesses, sondern als den ersten Höhepunkt einer langfristigen Kundenbeziehung.

  • Nachbetreuung: Sie orchestrieren nach der Übergabe in Abstimmung mit Vertrieb und Handelspartnern den laufenden Kontakt, holen Feedback ein, lösen Anliegen schnell und erkennen Anlässe für Zubehör, Service oder das nächste Fahrzeug.

  • Customer Journey weiterentwickeln: Sie werten Kundenfeedback und Zufriedenheitswerte aus, verbessern die Kontaktpunkte laufend und bringen Ideen für Kundenevents, Manufakturbesuche und Übergabeformate ein.

  • Daten, die tragen: Sie pflegen Kunden- und Auftragsdaten in CRM und ERP so, dass Vertrieb und Geschäftsleitung darauf Entscheidungen bauen.

Diese Rolle ist nicht die Sachbearbeitung hinter dem Vertrieb. Sie ist das Gesicht von Bovensiepen zwischen erster Anfrage und Schlüsselübergabe, und auch weit darüber hinaus.

Was Sie in den ersten zwölf Monaten bewegen

  • Sie lernen Kunden, Handelspartner, Manufaktur und Fahrzeuge kennen und führen die ersten Aufträge eigenverantwortlich zur Übergabe.

  • Sie zeichnen die heutige Customer Journey auf und benennen die Momente, die begeistern – und die, die wir verbessern.

  • Sie entwickeln ein Übergabe- und Nachbetreuungskonzept, das unsere Kunden so noch nicht erlebt haben und das nachhaltig in Erinnerung bleibt.

  • Sie bauen ein Angebot aus Sonderausstattung, Zusatzleistungen und Erlebnis auf, das zum Kunden passt und machen seinen Erfolg messbar.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil – Gastfreundschaft und Kaufmannsverstand

Sie haben ein echtes Gespür für Menschen und Freude daran, sie zu begeistern. Sie begegnen anspruchsvollen Kunden auf Augenhöhe, sprechen mit dem Sattler über Nahtbilder und behalten zehn Aufträge parallel im Blick, ohne dass einer aus dem Raster fällt. Sie verkaufen gern, weil Sie wissen, dass das richtige Angebot zur richtigen Zeit für den Kunden ein Gewinn ist.

Was Sie mitbringen

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Automobilkaufleute) oder Studium

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Order Management oder Vertrieb – im Premium-Automobilumfeld oder mit ähnlich anspruchsvoller Klientel, etwa bei Luxusmarken, in der Premium-Hotellerie oder im Private Banking

  • Freude am Verkaufen und nachweisbare Erfolge im Zusatz- oder Folgegeschäft

  • Begeisterung für hochwertige Fahrzeuge und den Willen, sich tief in deren Ausstattungswelt einzuarbeiten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM- (Creatio) und ERP-Systemen (z. B. Microsoft Business Central) und MS Office

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch, Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen für Übergaben

Was uns zusätzlich überzeugt

  • Erfahrung mit BMW oder anderen Premium-Marken

  • Erfahrung mit Individualisierungsprogrammen, Fahrzeugkonfiguration oder Kleinserien

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenevents, Clienteling oder Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit (z. B. NPS)

  • Weitere Fremdsprache (Englisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Japanisch) für die Betreuung internationaler Kunden

Was uns wichtiger ist als jedes Zertifikat: der Instinkt für Menschen, der Wille, jeden Auftrag zu Ende zu denken, und die Freude daran, für einen Kunden mehr möglich zu machen, als er erwartet hat.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

Familienunternehmen seit mehr als 60 Jahren: Kurze Wege zwischen Kunde, Manufaktur und Geschäftsleitung. Ihre Ideen landen nicht in einer Abstimmungsschleife, sondern bei den Menschen, die entscheiden.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Eine neue Rolle, die Sie von Beginn an prägen, mit klarer Verantwortung für das Kundenerlebnis

  • Erfolgsbeteiligung: Fixgehalt plus Bonus, gekoppelt an die Zusatzverkäufe und die Zufriedenheit Ihrer Kunden, damit Ihr Beitrag direkt sichtbar wird

  • Direkte Berichtslinie an die Vertriebsleitung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Manufaktur und Geschäftsleitung

  • Produktnähe: Fahrzeuge, die in Buchloe von Hand entstehen und leidenschaftliche Käufer, die Sie persönlich kennen und stets im Fokus halten

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Manufaktur und bei unseren Handelspartnern

  • Standort Buchloe im Allgäu: Hohe Lebensqualität, direkte Anbindung Richtung München, Memmingen und Augsburg

Bereit?

Wenn Sie diese Zeilen lesen und spüren, dass das für Sie mehr ist als eine Stellenanzeige, bewerben Sie sich.

jobs.description:
Site Reliability Engineer

About Us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.


About the role:

As a Site Reliability Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the reliability of the systems that leading law firms depend on every day. We run our AI search platform in dedicated production environments, each a large-scale search and retrieval system operating at very high data volumes, alongside our ingestion pipelines and data stores, on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds. Keeping those environments fast, available, and trustworthy is a genuine engineering challenge, and it's your mission.

This is a technical, infrastructure-focused role: you'll spend your time in systems, code, and telemetry. You'll harden the platform so that classes of failure can't recur, build observability and SLOs to let us see problems before they surface, plan capacity ahead of relentless data growth, and automate away the toil of safely operating many production environments. You'll work across our deployment and infrastructure-as-code and partner closely with product engineering to feed reliability learnings back into the platform. If you like operating serious distributed systems at scale and turning firefighting into engineered reliability, this role is for you.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the availability, latency and performance of our production environments: large-scale search and retrieval services, ingestion and data stores on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds

  • Owning the cloud infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds, networking, identity and access, compute and storage, and managing cloud capacity, quotas and cost as the fleet grows

  • Improving deployment and infrastructure through code: GitOps-based configuration and deployment and infrastructure-as-code across our public and private clouds, with safe, previewed, recoverable production changes

  • Defining and instrumenting SLOs and error budgets and building the dashboards, metrics and alerting that make production observable and actionable

  • Reducing operational toil through automation and internal tooling written in Python and / or Go

  • Provisioning and standardizing new production environments to a defined reliability bar

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years in SRE, production / platform engineering, or infrastructure-heavy software engineering, operating real production systems under reliability expectations

  • Are strong at container-orchestration operations in production and comfortable on at least one major public cloud

  • Have solid cloud infrastructure experience on a major public cloud and a working grasp of cloud capacity, quotas, and cost

  • Practice observability hands-on with metrics, logs and traces, and use it to root-cause live incidents

  • Work fluently with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps

  • Can code in Python and / or Go for automation, tooling, and reading and patching service code.

  • Bring sound production judgment and document your work clearly for other engineers

  • Bonus: experience operating a large-scale search or distributed data system, database operations, dedicated / enterprise-deployed software, or AI / enterprise-search infrastructure in regulated domains

What you can look forward to:

  • Owning the reliability of systems that the world's leading law firms rely on: real scale, real impact

  • Deep, hands-on work with modern infrastructure: distributed search at very large scale, container orchestration across multiple clouds, and a mature infrastructure-as-code and GitOps stack

  • A rigorous, high-urgency engineering culture founded by ex-Google search engineers and ETH Zurich AI PhDs

  • The chance to build the reliability discipline, SLOs, incident practice, automation, from a strong foundation, not inherit a rigid one

  • A collaborative team in Zurich shaping how AI transforms professional knowledge work

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Controller

MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken.

Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie.

Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie.

MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Project Control

  • Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts.

  • Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren.

  • Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow.

  • Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting.

  • Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen.

  • Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie.

  • Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering.

Financial Control

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen.

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces.

  • Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting.

  • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie.

  • Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages.

Business Control & Business Partnering

  • Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning.

  • Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses.

  • Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie.

  • Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning.

  • Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's.

  • Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming.


Wie zoeken wij?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar.

  • Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen.

  • Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants.

  • Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving.

  • Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing.

  • Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools.

  • Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

  • Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht.

  • In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders.

  • Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering.



Wat bieden wij?

Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie.
