jobs.title: Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01

Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01

Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten.

Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project.

 

Over de functie

Als Supply Chain Planner krijg je de kans om vanaf de basis mee te bouwen aan de supply chain van DSL-01. Jouw werk helpt de basis te leggen voor een betrouwbare operatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige productiefaciliteiten voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).

Je stapt op een uniek moment in een groeiende organisatie.

Voor de start van de fabriek:

  • Help je mee de supply chain-organisatie van DSL-01 op te bouwen, inclusief de processen, systemen en werkwijzen die nodig zijn voor operational readiness.

  • Draag je bij aan de inrichting van ERP-systemen, supply chain-processen en de voorbereiding van een veilige, betrouwbare en efficiënte operatie.

Na de start van de fabriek:

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in de dagelijkse supply chain-operatie, van grondstoffen- en productieplanning tot afstemming met leveranciers en afnemers.

  • Zorg je samen met interne en externe stakeholders voor een stabiele supply chain die een veilige en continue productie ondersteunt.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van productie-, supply- en offtakeplanningen voor de korte, middellange en lange termijn.

  • Vertalen van productiebehoeften naar materiaalvereisten en afstemmen van beschikbaarheid met leveranciers, Procurement en sourcing-teams.

  • Coördineren van planning tussen Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Procurement en commerciële stakeholders.

  • Signaleren van risico's, verstoringen en capaciteitsbeperkingen en ontwikkelen van passende scenario's en oplossingen.

  • Leveren van analyses en inzichten ter ondersteuning van het Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)-proces.

  • Actief bijdragen aan de inrichting, validatie en optimalisatie van ERP-systemen en supply chain-processen.

  • Ondersteunen van processen rondom traceability, certificering en mass balancing.

  • Initiëren en leiden van verbeteringen op het gebied van planning, systemen en werkwijzen.

  • Fungeren als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor complexe planningsvraagstukken tijdens operational readiness en de opstart van de fabriek.

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van operationele verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om een nieuwe supply chain-organisatie mee vorm te geven.

 

Jouw profiel

Je bent analytisch sterk, neemt eigenaarschap en voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Je bent in staat verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer informatie beperkt of onvolledig is.

Wat breng je mee?

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Supply Planner, Production Planner, Material Planner of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een productieomgeving.

  • Een sterk begrip van supply chain-processen en ERP-systemen.

  • Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om inzichten te vertalen naar acties en besluitvorming.

  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte houding en een sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement in een complexe operationele omgeving.

  • Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen onder onzekerheid.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Additionele vaardigheden/ervaring

  • Ervaring binnen de proces- en maakindustrie.

  • Ervaring met ERP-implementaties, systeeminrichting of user acceptance testing.

  • Ervaring met het opstarten van nieuwe productielocaties of operationele organisaties.

  • Kennis van traceability, certificering, mass balancing, dangerous goods of waste management.

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

 

Wat wij bieden

DSL-01 is volop in ontwikkeling. Dat geldt niet alleen voor de fabriek, maar ook voor de organisatie en de arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ons HR-team werkt aan een passend en marktconform pakket voor de locatie in Delfzijl.

Je kunt rekenen op een goed salaris, een bonusregeling en arbeidsvoorwaarden die ruimte bieden voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

 

Solliciteer

Wil jij meebouwen aan een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).

jobs.title: Senior Uitvoerder kabels & leidingen Railinfra
jobs.description:
Senior Uitvoerder kabels & leidingen Railinfra

Ambitie          
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen.

Als senior uitvoerder kabels & leidingen werk je aan ondergrondse infra rond het spoor en op stations door heel Nederland. Je stuurt uitvoerders, vakmensen en onderaannemers aan, houdt meerdere belangen bij elkaar en zorgt dat het werk doorgaat. Ook als de planning verandert of de situatie buiten anders blijkt dan gedacht. Je krijgt daarbij te maken met onder andere telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Werk waarbij veiligheid, goede afstemming en de juiste beslissing op het juiste moment het verschil maken.

Dit ga je doen 
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen. Als uitvoerder 3 kabels & leidingen stuur je medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers aan en houd je grip op planning, kwaliteit en kosten.

Je werkt aan ondergrondse infra binnen onze railprojecten, zoals telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Je stuurt één of meerdere projecten tegelijk aan en houdt het overzicht, ook als het anders loopt dan gepland. Je gaat:

  • je team aansturen en motiveren, met duidelijke afspraken en ruimte voor vakmanschap;

  • veiligheid vooropzetten en collega's stimuleren risico’s en verbeteringen te delen;

  • plannen en bijsturen, prioriteiten stellen en knopen doorhakken als dat nodig is;

  • kwaliteit en kosten bewaken, inclusief het meer- en minderwerk;

  • schakelen met betrokken partijen, van je team en collega's tot ProRail, OV-bedrijven en netbeheerders;

  • verbeteringen aanjagen door kritisch te kijken, te luisteren en goede ideeën om te zetten in actie.

Je hoeft niet overal zelf naast te staan. Maar als het erop aankomt, weet jij wat er buiten speelt, ben je er en neem je een besluit.


Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Dit verwachten wij van jou
Je bent een ervaren uitvoerder die overzicht houdt en duidelijk communiceert. Je weet wanneer je ruimte kunt geven en wanneer jij degene bent die een beslissing moet nemen. Voor deze rol breng je mee:

  • relevante ervaring met het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van ondergrondse infraprojecten;

  • ervaring met het aansturen van medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers;

  • een technische basis, bijvoorbeeld vanuit civiele techniek, elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde;

  • een scherpe blik op veiligheid, kwaliteit, planning en kosten;

  • het vermogen om rustig te blijven, prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen;

  • de communicatieve kracht om verschillende partijen bij elkaar te brengen;

  • bereidheid om te werken wanneer het spoorwerk daarom vraagt, ook buiten reguliere werktijden.

We verwachten niet dat je ieder probleem zelf oplost. Wel dat je ervoor zorgt dat problemen op tafel komen, de juiste mensen betrokken zijn en er uiteindelijk een besluit wordt genomen.

Waarom Dura Vermeer Railinfra?      
Hier krijg je de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen én verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je organiseert je werk met veel zelfstandigheid en krijgt mogelijkheden om jezelf via opleidingen verder te ontwikkelen.

En je werkt niet zomaar aan kabels en leidingen. Jouw werk is onderdeel van railprojecten waarin verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Dat vraagt om samenwerken, vooruitkijken en beslissingen nemen als het buiten anders loopt dan gepland.

Veilig werken staat daarbij voorop. In hoe je het werk organiseert, je team aanstuurt en de keuzes die je buiten maakt.


Wij hebben oog voor jou

Dura Vermeer is een grote organisatie waarin je veel kunt leren en waarin je kansen hebt om je ambities vorm te geven. Daarbij hechten we veel waarde aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief. We hebben goede arbeidsvoorwaarden conform CAO Railinfrastructuur (RIS). Dus bieden we je onder meer:

  • Een goed salaris afhankelijk van de meegebrachte kennis, niveau en werkervaring beginnend bij € 4.620,- tot € 5.775,- bruto per 4 weken en dus 13 maal per jaar!;

  • 25 vakantiedagen + 18 ADV dagen (beide op fulltime basis)

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een standaard verzekering van alle werknemersrisico’s, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden en thuiswerken en moderne verlofvormen voor onder meer ouderschap, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of een sabbatical.

  • Voor verse vaders: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens je (aanvullende) geboorteverlof.

  • Een zeer goede beloning wanneer je de nachten of weekenden gaat werken

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei, met onze eigen Dura Vermeer academie en een vergoeding in tijd en geld voor zowel vak- als loopbaangerichte opleidingen.

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget of een leaseauto met grote keuzevrijheid. Smartphone en een laptop of tablet van de zaak.

  • Een vitaliteitsprogramma en een individueel keuzebudget voor duurzame inzetbaarheid.

  • En last but not least: fijne collega’s die in een professionele omgeving zorgen voor een ongekend goede werksfeer.

Heb jij ook hart voor het spoor?

Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteer via onderstaande button.

Nog vragen? Stel ze!

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
People Business Partner

Job: People Business Partner
Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue, one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won: the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue, and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

As a People Business Partner (PBP), you are the strategic people advisor to the leaders in your respective business units. You own the outcomes in partnership with your key stakeholders: the people strategy, the risk, and the quality of every program that touches your teams, your time goes to advising, calibrating, and solving. You'll regularly partner with Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Benefits, and Legal.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:

  • Talent Strategy & Workforce Architecture. Partner closely with department leaders to design and execute forward-looking talent strategies, including comprehensive workforce planning, advanced organizational design, and robust succession planning.
  • Trusted Advisor & Coach. Act as a trusted partner to executives, directors, and front-line managers on team design, growth, and people decisions, and help drive the people strategy for your population.
  • Change Management & Organizational Agility: Spearhead strategic change management initiatives to support business transformation, rapid scaling, and continuous operational improvement across your dedicated client groups.
  • Lead calibration. Run talent calibration and review conversations for your entire population, lead promotion calibration, manage leadership communications, and make sure growth and development stay a priority for managers.
  • Drive engagement. Review engagement results with leaders at every level, align on action plans, and make sure they get done, including working directly with front-line managers.
  • Own employee relations. Oversee complex employee relations matters, including thorough investigations, ensuring strict adherence to fairness, risk mitigation, and continuous alignment with our core cultural values.
  • Evidence Over Ego. Analyze workforce trends and HRIS metrics to formulate and recommend data-driven action plans that tangibly improve employee engagement and retention.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're a credible, business-minded People Partner, embedded within the business, who can build trust with a front-line manager and a senior executive on the same day. You give candid advice, balance empathy with sound judgment, and make good decisions under pressure. You also delegate well and are comfortable with a model that separates strategic ownership from administration. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this role offers real scope and visibility.

THE TEAM

Our PBPs and Shared Services work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership. We are results-oriented and warm, we take on hard problems together, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for accountability, empathy and execution.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

THE SKILL SET:

  • 4+ years of progressive HR experience, including 2+ years as an HR Business Partner or equivalent supporting a technology or SaaS organization.
  • Experience partnering with department leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, and succession planning.
  • Strong ability to advise executives, directors, and front-line managers on team design, growth, and people decisions, and shaping people strategy for a defined population.
  • Competent in leading leaders through organizational change, including business transformation, rapid scaling, or restructuring.
  • Facilitation experience in running talent and promotion calibration, and reinforcing growth and development with managers.
  • Analyze engagement results to bring insights to leaders and drive action plans through completion, including with front-line managers.
  • Demonstrated depth in employee relations: leading complex investigations, recommending outcomes, and executing terminations, with a focus on fairness, risk mitigation, and alignment with company values.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn workforce and HRIS data into recommendations that improve engagement and retention.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and discretion with confidential information.
  • Experience supporting Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Engineering teams is preferred
  • Experience with HiBob or a similar HRIS, plus Google Workspace is preferred
  • Experience with global mobility, supporting teams internationally, engagement survey action planning, or high-growth and private-equity-backed environments is preferred.
  • HR certification (SHRM-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR) is preferred.

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

jobs.title: AI Senior Engineer (Vision)
jobs.description:
AI Senior Engineer (Vision)

Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

What you’ll be doing

We are seeking someone who enjoys working at the cutting edge where Computer Vision meets Logic. You will be responsible for the "eyes" and the "brain" of our system—extracting complex data from visual documents and then orchestrating how that data is used by Large Language Models.

In short, someone who likes:

  • Unlocking Visual Data: Building pipelines that can "read" complex documents, understanding layout, charts, and visual context using Vision-Language Models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5) and Layout Analysis.
  • Orchestrating Intelligence: Owning the application logic layer. You will use LangChain or LangGraph to build the agents and chains that query our data, reason about it, and generate responses.
  • Native PDF Handling: Handling the messy reality of PDF processing (PyMuPDF, layout parsing) to preserve structure before the AI even sees it.
  • Prompt Engineering & Logic: Crafting complex prompts and control flows to ensure models interpret financial charts and layouts accurately without hallucinating.
  • Cost & Scale: Applying a cost-optimization mindset (batch processing, model selection) to ensure our vision and orchestration layers are economically viable.

What we’re looking for

We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps.

Ideally, they would also have:

  • LLM Orchestration (Must Have): Deep experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. You know how to manage context windows, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
  • Multimodal AI Experience: Hands-on experience integrating state-of-the-art vision models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) and embedding models (CLIP).
  • Document Intelligence Specialist: Familiarity with specialized models (e.g., Donut, Pix2Struct) and tools like Unstructured.io or Docling.
  • PDF Processing Mastery: Mastery over tools like PyMuPDF or pdfplumber for native element extraction.
  • Python ML Stack: Strong proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning vision or language models, specifically to improve accuracy on domain-specific artifacts like financial charts or tables.
  • Domain Knowledge: Prior experience handling documents in the Real Estate or Finance sectors.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.
  • Payments made in USD.
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.
  • Wellness + Remote Stipend
  • AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

Full-Time LATAM

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

The Accounting Manager, Fixed Assets & Capital Accounting is a high-impact individual contributor role within the Corporate Accounting organization. This individual will serve as the subject matter expert and end-to-end operational owner for ŌURA’s global capital assets, corporate facility investments (including leasehold improvements and tenant allowances), internally developed software (ASC 350-40), lease accounting portfolio (ASC 842), and associated capital expenditure (CAPEX) workflows.

This role requires a seasoned accounting professional with the technical rigor to own SOX control execution, the operational initiative to design and scale agile processes as the business evolves, and the cross-functional influence to partner effectively with Engineering, Supply Chain, IT, Facilities, Marketing, and Legal. The ideal candidate brings deep domain expertise to ensure capital assets, software investments, and lease liabilities are accurately accounted for and presented across the Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and Statement of Cash Flows, while remaining eager to support broader Corporate Accounting team initiatives.

Core Responsibilities

1. Capital Asset, Real Estate, & Lease Accounting Execution

  • Fixed Asset & LHI Lifecycle Management: Drive end-to-end accounting for Property, Plant, and Equipment (PP&E), intangibles, Construction-in-Progress (CIP), and Leasehold Improvements (LHIs). Track facility build-outs, ensure proper capitalization timing, evaluate Tenant Improvement (TI) allowances, and align amortization schedules with lease terms.
  • Internally Developed Software (ASC 350-40): Own the end-to-end accounting framework for internal-use software capitalization. Establish cross-functional processes with Product, Engineering, and IT to identify qualifying projects, track stage-by-stage development costs (preliminary, application development, post-implementation), and enforce proper capitalization/amortization discipline.
  • Lease Accounting (ASC 842) Ownership: Manage the global corporate lease accounting portfolio, verifying contract classifications, discount rates, schedule additions/modifications, facility lease components, and monthly Right-of-Use (ROU) asset and liability reconciliations.
  • Cash Flow Presentation & Financial Integrity: Ensure the precise accuracy and financial statement presentation of fixed assets, capitalized software, lease liabilities, facility CAPEX, and non-cash adjustments within the primary financial statements, with a strong focus on the Statement of Cash Flows.
  • Impairment & Valuation Analysis: Partner with Technical Accounting to establish frameworks for evaluating asset impairment indicators (including software obsolescence, facility abandonments, or subleases), conducting annual or trigger-based valuation reviews, and executing necessary write-offs or reserve adjustments.

2. Scalable Process Design & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Scalable Process Architecture: Design, implement, and continuously refine agile, future-ready capital accounting processes that adapt cleanly to changes in business model, product strategy, and organizational growth.
  • Cross-Functional Asset Discovery: Establish proactive, cross-functional discovery procedures with IT, Engineering, Facilities, and Procurement to systematically identify capital asset purchases, new lease agreements, and software initiatives across the organization as they arise.
  • Policy Authoring & Operationalization: Author, update, and enforce global Capital Asset, Software Capitalization, and Lease Accounting policies, setting clear capitalization thresholds, physical inventory mandates, facility tracking rules, and documentation standards.
  • Business Partnership & Guidance: Serve as the primary finance contact for business partners across Facilities, Real Estate, IT, Engineering, Product, and Supply Chain, providing clear guidance on CAPEX vs. OPEX distinctions and capital project tracking.

3. Systems Evaluation, Automation, & General Corporate Accounting Support

  • Systems Evaluation & Transformation: Act as the business owner and lead evaluator for fixed asset management systems, lease accounting software (e.g., LeaseQuery, Lucernex, or NetSuite modules), and asset-tracking tools, partnering with IT/Transformation to automate workflows.
  • Ad Hoc Corporate Accounting Projects: Serve as a versatile contributor within the Corporate Accounting team, actively participating in special projects, system upgrades, technical accounting implementation, and broader close-optimization initiatives as assigned.

4. SOX Ownership, Internal Controls, & Audit

  • Control Ownership & Design: Own and execute SOX internal controls across Fixed Assets, Lease Accounting, and Capitalized Software domains, ensuring compliance across key control assertions: Existence, Completeness, Rights & Obligations, Valuation, and Cutoff.
  • Physical Inventories & Verification: Design, lead, and audit periodic physical inventory counts and fixed asset verification programs (including corporate facilities, remote office assets, and hardware) to confirm existence and condition.
  • Audit Interface: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for external auditors for all capital asset, LHI, capitalized software, CIP, and lease workpapers, walkthroughs, and technical memo fulfillment.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 6–8+ years of progressive corporate accounting experience, with at least 4+ years of dedicated ownership over fixed assets, capital expenditure (CAPEX), leasehold improvements, capitalized software, and lease accounting (ASC 842) in a pre-IPO or public-company environment.
  • Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in US GAAP, specifically ASC 360 (Property, Plant, and Equipment), ASC 350-40 (Internal-Use Software), and ASC 842 (Leases), alongside a comprehensive understanding of capital asset impacts on the Statement of Cash Flows.
  • Facility & Software Expertise: Direct experience accounting for real estate transactions, facility build-outs, leasehold improvement amortization, tenant improvement (TI) allowances, and agile software development capitalization.
  • Individual Contributor Level: Senior Manager / Manager level expertise with the autonomy, confidence, and executive presence required to build cross-functional discovery frameworks without needing direct management authority over business partners.
  • SOX Expertise: Proven track record of designing, documenting, and executing SOX internal controls and leading physical asset existence and completeness audits.
  • Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience operating and implementing specialized fixed asset and lease management modules within Tier-1 ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, Oracle, SAP).
  • Industry Background: Experience in hardware, consumer technology, software, manufacturing, or capital-intensive businesses is highly preferred.
  • Education/Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance and CPA required.

Benefits

jobs.description:
Director of Facilities

Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We are looking for a Director of Facilities to lead the strategy, operations, and optimization of Pattern’s warehouse facilities and physical infrastructure. This role will oversee the ongoing operations and maintenance of our warehouse locations, while leading facility expansions, renovations, build-outs, and new warehouse launches to support Pattern’s continued growth. It combines day-to-day facilities and maintenance leadership with hands-on ownership of vendor performance, safety/compliance, and space readiness.

This is a full-time remote position that requires approximately 30% travel to Pattern’s U.S. warehouse locations.

What is a day in the life of a Director of Facilities?

  • Oversee daily facilities operations including maintenance, security, janitorial, and vendor management in partnership with the lease management team

  • Develop and execute a facilities and reliability strategy aligned with company growth, including space planning and workplace design

  • Manage budgets, capital expenditures, and cost optimization initiatives across facilities

  • Lead office expansions, renovations, and build-outs in partnership with internal stakeholders and external vendors, ensuring spaces are truly operationally ready — not just construction-complete

  • Establish preventive maintenance discipline, escalation routines, and vendor follow-up so facility risks are surfaced early and driven to closure

  • Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, building codes, and environmental standards (OSHA, NFPA, electrical/life-safety, permitting)

  • Partner cross-functionally with IT, People Ops, Safety, Real Estate/Construction, and leadership to enhance the employee workplace experience

What will I need to thrive in this role?

  • Significant leadership experience in facilities management, maintenance/reliability, workplace operations, or a related field

  • Proven experience managing small and large office or site environments, preferably in a high-growth or tech company

  • Proven experience leading the launch of new office spaces or facilities, including site selection support, design, construction coordination, and operational readiness

  • Strong knowledge of building systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing) and vendor management

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate, redesign, and optimize existing facilities to meet evolving business needs, improve employee experience, and drive cost and space efficiency

  • Experience managing leases, budgets, contracts, and capital projects

  • Ability to identify technical, safety, and compliance risk, know when to bring in outside experts, and drive issues to closure

  • High EQ and excellent leadership and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive, data-driven approach to decision making

  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed to support site readiness and vendor coordination

What does high performance look like?

  • Facilities operations run smoothly with minimal disruptions and high employee satisfaction

  • Projects (build-outs, expansions, upgrades) are delivered on time and within budget, with clean handoff and no late surprises

  • Strong vendor relationships and preventive maintenance discipline that drive quality service and cost efficiency

  • Continuous improvement in workplace experience, safety, and operational efficiency

  • Proactive identification and resolution of facility risks or inefficiencies, with the right issues escalated to leadership and the rest resolved independently

What will make me stand out during the interview process?

  • Experience in Amazon RME, fulfillment, sort center, AMZL, Sub Same Day, distribution, logistics, manufacturing, robotics, parcel, ecommerce, or other high-throughput operating environments

  • Experience with conveyors, sorters, MHE, dock equipment, building systems, fire/life-safety coordination, electrical safety, controls, WCS/WES interfaces, or automated material handling environments

  • Experience developing PM programs, scorecards, inspection routines, vendor standards, critical-spares processes, and maintenance operating mechanisms

  • Experience with greenfield launches, brownfield retrofits, tenant improvements, startup readiness, or network expansion

  • Familiarity with OSHA, NFPA, electrical safety, insurance review, permitting, facility inspections, and industrial safety practices

  • Military, engineering, technical operations, or field leadership background

We are looking for individuals who are:

Game Changers - A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.

Data Fanatics - A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.

Partner Obsessed - An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.

Team of Doers - Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

  • Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team

  • Video interview with a hiring manager

  • Video case study interview with the Operations and Facilities/Reliability team

  • Onsite interviews with panels of department leaders

  • Professional reference checks

  • Executive review

  • Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

  • Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples - PM compliance gains, launch timelines, scorecard improvements, and risk closure

  • Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team

  • Focus on mentioning how you would be partner obsessed at Pattern

  • Be prepared to talk about specific examples of site launches, facilities turnarounds, or maintenance/reliability programs you've built or led

Compensation

Additional Information

Why should I work at Pattern?

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

Senior Technical Program Manager - Security

About the Team

OpenAI builds powerful AI systems like ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and enterprise products that serve millions of users across the globe. As we scale, securing our infrastructure, protecting sensitive data, and meeting global compliance standards are essential to our success and societal impact.

Security at OpenAI is a cross-cutting function that spans infrastructure, applied engineering, legal, policy, and product. Technical Program Managers (TPMs) play a critical leadership role in aligning teams and delivering execution at scale and this role will be foundational in shaping how we secure OpenAI’s systems, users, and commitments.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive cross-functional security, privacy, IT and compliance initiatives at the intersection of infrastructure, product, and policy. You will execute complex programs that reduce internal data access, prevent misuse, and ship security capabilities. You will focus your efforts on the most critical initiatives within Security, crossing the spectrum of insider threat, information security, physical security, and information technology challenges.

This role is deeply technical and execution-focused. It requires a structured operator who thrives in ambiguity, partners effectively across boundaries, and applies principled judgment to scale trust, governance, and security across OpenAI’s systems and products.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive execution of critical security and compliance programs such as vulnerability management, merger and acquisition security and integration, infrastructure hardening, and datacenter security management. You will need to deeply collaborate on technical architecture and resolve technical problems in partnership with engineering.

  • Partner with IT, Infrastructure, Application, Legal, Privacy, and Security teams to build scalable programs, and deliver critical security outcomes across multiple disciplines, including insider threat, information security, physical security, and information technology.

  • Establish scalable frameworks and build programs around critical security initiatives including vulnerability management, evidence collection, incident response coordination, supply chain risk management, and device security.

  • Track and enforce OpenAI’s privacy and security requirements by translating commitments into engineering milestones and driving their full implementation across systems.

  • Create and maintain program-level visibility across risk areas, security milestones, and cross-org dependencies—ensuring outcomes are delivered reliably and at high quality.

  • Communicate status, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to technical and executive audiences and drive cross-functional execution with urgency and care.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are an empathetic communicator and leader—able to influence across technical and non-technical audiences, and build durable trust with partners.

  • Have 5+ years of experience leading complex technical programs focused on infrastructure security, data privacy, compliance, or enterprise platform capabilities.

  • Are deeply fluent in the intersection of engineering systems, security controls, and regulatory expectations—and are able to bring clarity and structure across all three.

  • Thrive in high-trust environments, bring rigor and systems thinking to ambiguity, and operate with a bias for aligned execution over org boundaries.

  • Are structured, detail-oriented, and rigorous in ensuring quality, accountability, and durable delivery.

  • Have a proven record of success driving highly cross-functional efforts across engineering, infrastructure, legal, compliance, and product stakeholders.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: PhD Research Intern, 3D World Models
jobs.description:
PhD Research Intern, 3D World Models

SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

 

We're looking for bold, innovative individuals driven by a passion for pushing the boundaries of generative 3D AI. You should thrive in an environment where creativity meets technical challenge and be fearless in tackling the hardest problems in 3D world modeling. Our team is built on a foundation of dedication and a shared commitment to excellence, so we value people who take immense pride in their work and place the collective goals of the team above personal ambition. As a part of SpAItial, you'll be at the forefront of building World Models that bridge generative AI and the physical world. If you're ready to make an impact, embrace the unknown, and collaborate with a talented group of visionaries, we want to hear from you.

 

We're seeking PhD Research Interns to work with our research team on open problems in 3D generation and reconstruction. You should have strong knowledge of at least one of our core areas, such as generative video and diffusion models, scene representations like Gaussian splats and radiance fields, or 3D reconstruction from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. Over a 5-7 month internship, you will own a well-defined research question with the goal of publishing a paper.

 

Responsibilities

  • You will explore novel research directions in 3D generation, reconstruction, and world models.

  • You will design, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art methods, turning innovative research ideas into working systems and prototypes.

  • You will be working closely with our research team.

  • You will also present your findings and contribute to scientific publications targeting leading conferences in computer vision, computer graphics, and machine learning, such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, and ICLR.

Key Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in the third year or beyond of a PhD in computer science, computer vision, computer graphics, machine learning, or a related field.

  • 2-3 first-author papers at top-tier conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or ICLR.

  • Knowledge of at least one of: generative models (diffusion or video models), neural scene representations, or 3D reconstruction.

 

At SpAItial, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process.

Enterprise account manager, northern europe

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We're hiring two account managers in London to retain and grow Watershed's customers across northern Europe. We're at an inflection point: large companies across the region are launching and scaling sustainability programmes as regulatory and investor pressure builds every day. You'll do whatever it takes to make sure those companies are successful, happy, and continuing with Watershed. As founding members of our first account management team in Europe, you'll help build the renewal and expansion playbook for the region, shape Watershed's product, and help us build a stellar team.

You will:

  • Own and grow a book of enterprise customers. Work with the right people across each account, educate them about effective sustainability programmes, and help them drive continuous improvement and business value with Watershed. You'll own the full commercial relationship after the sale, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

  • Build the renewal and expansion playbook for northern Europe. How do we best position new products to our customers? What's the best risk mitigation strategy? Where can we build stronger connections across key stakeholders? You'll turn the answers into a repeatable machine.

  • Shape Watershed's product, packaging, and go-to-market strategy for new products by sharing feedback from customers on the front line.

  • Become an expert in sustainability, and educate companies on how to navigate regulatory reporting (including CSRD), carbon reduction targets, clean energy, carbon removal, and decarbonising their supply chains.

  • Help build the account management team in Europe.

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years of sales or account management excellence, especially with enterprise customers (10,000+ employees) at an executive level.

  • Have 3+ years of demonstrated success selling, renewing, and expanding enterprise SaaS at €100K-500K deal sizes.

  • Have managed enterprise accounts across northern Europe and know how buying decisions, procurement, and stakeholder dynamics work in the region.

  • Are excited to lead from zero to one. You love to build things from scratch: new playbooks for navigating organisations and new ways to tell the Watershed story.

  • Are an excellent consultative seller. You listen deeply to customers and excel by helping them solve their problems.

  • Love going deep on new domains. You've sold products in complex or technical fields, and relish becoming an expert on your subject matter. You're voraciously curious. You're excited to learn everything about sustainability and help companies navigate this space.

  • Have a track record of doing whatever it takes to get things done. You've accomplished things that others thought were impossible. You're relentlessly resourceful.

  • Want to join a startup, take responsibility for the fate of the company, and move fast.

The role might include up to 20% travel across northern europe.

Must be willing to work from our London office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer I
jobs.description:
Solution Engineer I

Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

As a Solutions Engineer I in the Connect team, you'll support the partners who bring processing volume to Mollie, think SaaS platforms and marketplaces. Your core activities are discovery, solution design, and implementation support for partner deals, the work that turns a promising conversation into a working integration.

Beyond the deal itself, you'll join forecasting meetings with the Connect leadership team to give an honest, objective view of technical deal health, and you'll have regular one-on-ones with the partner acquisition managers you support to align on deal details and next steps. You'll also support events and pitches for the commercial team and contribute to process improvement and internal product feedback, so the lessons from one deal make the next one easier.

Solutions Engineers are the bridge between technical and commercial teams at Mollie. Strong discovery means partners get solutions that actually fit, pricing negotiations become smoother, and partner needs and product issues make their way back into the business. That's a direct line to how Mollie expands into new products and partner segments.

What you'll ship

  • Lead technical discovery sessions to deeply understand and map complex merchant requirements.

  • Design and present tailored payment solutions, clearly mapping Mollie’s APIs and products to specific business needs.

  • Build and deliver custom demos, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical workshops that prove our value.

  • Act as the technical expert in the room, partnering with Account Executives to overcome objections and close strategic deals.

  • Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering teams, channeling critical merchant feedback to help shape our product roadmap.

What you'll bring

  • 2 to 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing, technical role.

  • Customer-facing experience with a technical product, such as pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical customer success

  • Comfortable working with APIs, with the ability to demo and build solutions on top of them

  • Strong discovery skills: understanding what a partner needs and judging what's feasible with the product

  • Ability to explain a complex product, including payment methods, sub-products, and the Connect proposition, to both technical and commercial audiences

  • Experience working with both internal and external senior executives stakeholders

  • A technically curious, commercially minded, and customer-minded approach, with clear rules of engagement, comfortable saying no and pushing back when needed

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

Stage veiligheidskunde

Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze veiligheidsadviseur in de praktijk van veiligheid op de bouwplaats. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over veiligheidstrainingen: jij maakt impact.

Dit wordt jouw stage

Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Je geeft zelf richting aan de werkzaamheden door verantwoordelijkheid te laten zien. Jij bepaalt, samen met je begeleider hoe jouw stageperiode eruit komt te zien. Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Neem dan eens een kijkje op onze website.

Dit breng je mee

  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector;

  • Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden;

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Mortgage Sales Recruiter

RenoFi is hiring a recruiter to join our fast-growing, early-stage startup. As a sales-focused recruiter, you will be responsible for recruiting Senior Loan Officers with a proven track record of self-sourcing leads. Senior Loan Officers are able to offer the full range of RenoFi’s loan product suite, including RenoFi’s exclusive home equity renovation loans.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

  • Own the end-to-end recruiting process for Senior Loan Officer candidates - you’ll be their trusted contact and guide them from initial outreach and screening, to coordination of interviews with the team, and through the offer and reference check stages
  • Engage with Sales leadership team to understand priorities for each market and corresponding resourcing needs
  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and key stakeholders and coach them on hiring best practices
  • Own the job posting process for various roles, including the drafting of job specs and posting to relevant sites including LinkedIn
  • Manage and maintain the talent pipeline and leverage the data to inform hiring projections
  • Maintain the ATS and provide timely and thoughtful feedback to all candidates to maintain data integrity
  • Leverage all RenoFi recruiting platforms to actively engage and source candidates
  • Validate potential candidate’s mortgage production using data sources such as MMI
  • Provide weekly updates to key stakeholders on activities and pipeline
  • Champion RenoFi’s culture & vision

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Preference will be given to candidates with significant experience in recruiting loan officers and sales roles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven negotiation skills
  • Excellent time management and attention to detail
  • Flexible and responsive to feedback, comfortable navigating ambiguity
  • Committed to maintaining a high level of professionalism
  • Proficient with Google Suite & ATS platforms – Our team uses Lever

Compensation

Compensation comprised of competitive base salary plus performance-based bonuses.

Additional Information

This role reports to our EVP of National Production and will work closely with our Retail Sales team.

We are committed to hiring and cultivating a diverse team. If you are uncertain about whether you meet our requirements, please apply anyway!

ABOUT US:

The demand for home renovations has never been stronger, yet, it's surprisingly difficult for a new homeowner to renovate. It can take a decade to build up enough home equity and savings to pay for a major renovation. As a result, recent homeowners do a lot of financially-suboptimal things to compensate like borrow from their 401k, rack up credit card debt, and use high-interest personal loans. Or they just live unhappily for years in a home that doesn't meet their family's needs.

But by completing a major renovation, homeowners are increasing the value of their home. Professional real estate investors leverage this After Renovation Value (ARV) to roll the increase in value into new properties all the time. But there hasn't been a great way for homeowners to take advantage of this. If homeowners had an ability to borrow against the ARV, they could increase their borrowing power up to 10x.

To meet this need, RenoFi created a platform that enables homeowners to borrow funds from RenoFi approved lenders in the form of the first home equity loan purpose-built for renovations! Unlike standard home equity loans, RenoFi Loans use the value of your home post-renovation which lets you borrow the most money at the best possible terms. RenoFi is creating a full suite of renovation loan products to better suit the needs of today’s homeowners!

For homeowners, RenoFi makes it possible to renovate years earlier than might be otherwise feasible. For contractors, we empower the financing of renovations at the point of sale, reducing instances of scope reduction, and ensuring prompt payment. Our lender partners, most often credit unions, rely on RenoFi's platform to generate loans, create efficiencies, and grow membership. The lenders pay RenoFi for the new loans, which allows us to offer our services to homeowners for free. RenoFi is truly a win-win-win for everyone involved.

RenoFi is backed by some of the best startup investors in the world, including First Round Capital, Comcast Ventures, and Canaan Partners.

Founder’s Associate – Operations & AI (all genders)

Über TradeLink

TradeLink baut agentische Plattformen, die europäische Lieferketten auf ein neues Level bringen. Routineaufgaben werden dabei von intelligenten KI-Agenten übernommen, wichtige Entscheidungen und Priorisierungen bleiben in den Teams. Ein Netzwerk, das Unternehmen, Lieferanten und Spediteure verbindet, sorgt für maximale Transparenz, reduziert Zeitverluste und schafft einen sicheren und vertrauensvollen Prozess. Mit TradeLink hat man seine Logistik jederzeit im Griff, statt ihr hinterherzurennen.

Über die Rolle

Wir sind intern auf dem Weg zur AI-native Org. Unser Firmenwissen liegt in einem Git-Repo, aus dem AI schöpft und arbeitet und das sich über Feedback Loops selbst aktualisiert. Inbound-Anfragen, Pod-Reports, Support-Triage und Call-Recaps laufen über Agenten und Automationen, die wir selbst gebaut haben. Mehr als 20 davon sind in Produktion.

In dieser Rolle bist du für das Backbone von TradeLink zuständig: die Systeme und Abläufe in Operations, People, Finance und GTM, auf die sich alle Teams jeden Tag verlassen. Du treibst AI-Projekte in der ganzen Firma voran und machst unsere Abläufe schlanker, schneller und effizienter. Dabei bekommst du Einblick in alle Bereiche des Unternehmens, vom Vertrieb über Produkt und Kunden bis zu People und Finance.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und Gründer Tobias und mit Daniel, unserem Chief of Staff und AI Enablement Manager, zusammen und machst die Firma jede Woche ein Stück besser. Für dich ist die Rolle ein Sprungbrett: Von hier aus kannst du dich in jeden Unternehmensbereich weiterentwickeln, der zu dir passt.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • People & Finance Operations AI-first umbauen: Du übernimmst unsere People- und Finance-Abläufe, verschlankst sie und automatisierst sie Schritt für Schritt. Das Ziel: Abläufe laufen pünktlich, haben einen Prüfschritt und finden Fehler, bevor sie beim Empfänger ankommen.

  • Operations schlank und kosteneffizient halten: Du behältst im Blick, wofür wir Geld und Zeit ausgeben, und sorgst dafür, dass wir effizient bleiben. Dafür prüfst du laufend Tools, Verträge und Abläufe, findest Doppelarbeit und Medienbrüche und managst Kündigungen, Nachverhandlungen, Implementierungen und Vereinfachungen

  • Arbeit an Agenten übergeben: Du betreibst laufende Automationen mit (Make, Claude, HubSpot, GitLab) und baust neue für wiederkehrende Arbeit in Vertrieb, Support, Reporting, People und Finance. Vor jedem Projekt legst du fest, woran wir den Erfolg messen, etwa gesparte Stunden, weniger Fehler oder erzeugte Pipeline.

  • GTM-Systeme und Customer Enablement: Du fährst Outbound-Kampagnen für unsere Zielaccounts und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Weg von der Anfrage bis zum ersten Gespräch schnell bleibt. Du baust das Reporting mit, über das unsere Teams ihre Accounts steuern. Außerdem arbeitest du am AI-native Self-Onboarding mit: Aus deinen Analysen leiten wir Builds ab, die Kundenanfragen und damit Tickets reduzieren.

  • Das Firmen-Gehirn weiterentwickeln: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Firmenwissen (Positionierung, Personas, Plays, Account Maps) aktuell ist und genutzt wird. Du zeigst Teams, wie sie damit arbeiten, misst, ob sie es tun, und verbesserst es, wenn nicht.

Nach 90 Tagen

  • laufen unsere Standardprozesse in People, Finance und GTM spürbar runder, schlanker und mit mehr Automatisierung als heute,

  • kennst du die Firma in der ganzen Breite und weißt, wie die Bereiche zusammenhängen,

  • erkennst du, wo es hakt, kannst Abläufe und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen und unterstützt das Management-Team so, dass es sich auf die wichtigen Entscheidungen konzentrieren kann

  • nutzt ein Team mindestens eine Lösung, die du gebaut hast, und spart dadurch jede Woche Zeit.

Nach 12 bis 18 Monaten verantwortest du einen Bereich selbst. Wohin es geht, entscheiden wir zusammen: GTM Engineering, Operations, AI Transformation Consultant beim Kunden, Product Builder oder der Weg in Richtung Chief of Staff.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mit AI oder Automationen etwas gebaut, das andere nutzen, und kannst es zeigen. Womit, ist egal: Make, n8n, Claude Code, ein Custom GPT mit eigenem Kontext, ein Python-Skript.

  • Erste Erfahrung in einem Startup, Scale-up, in der Beratung oder im VC. Praktika, Werkstudium oder eine eigene Gründung zählen.

  • Du prüfst AI-Output, bevor du ihn weitergibst, und kannst erklären, wo deine Tools versagen.

  • Du schreibst klar: kurze Memos und Anleitungen, mit denen jemand ohne dich weiterarbeiten kann.

  • Du bist sicher mit Zahlen und merkst, wenn eine Summe nicht stimmen kann.

  • Du gehst sorgfältig mit vertraulichen Informationen um.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und gutes Englisch.

  • Du lernst jede Woche etwas Neues über AI und weißt genau, was du dir zuletzt selbst beigebracht hast

Pluspunkte: Erfahrung in Recruiting, People Operations, Billing oder Finance Operations, eine Outbound-Kampagne, die du schon selbst gefahren hast, Git und Markdown, etwas Python oder SQL, HubSpot.

Die Stelle passt nicht, wenn

  • du eine Assistenzrolle mit Kalender und Reiseplanung suchst,

  • du mit ChatGPT arbeitest, aber noch nichts gebaut hast, das jemand anderes nutzt,

  • du erst loslegst, wenn ein fertiges Briefing vorliegt,

  • du Strategie machen und die Umsetzung anderen überlassen willst.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Bauen ab Woche 1: Claude, ChatGPT und das Tool-Budget, das deine Builds brauchen, und eine Führungskraft, die selbst baut.

  • Breite, die es selten gibt: GTM, AI, Operations in einer Rolle, direkt mit dem Management.

  • Impact, Innovation & Ownership: Gestalte unser schnell wachsendes, AI-natives B2B-Startup in der Logistik mit. Wir arbeiten in kleinen, fokussierten Pods, in denen jede:r echte Ergebnisse verantwortet – nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeitet. Nimm Einfluss auf Produkt, Kundenlösungen, Wachstum und Marke. Wir denken groß, handeln schnell und lösen echte Probleme.

  • AI-Powered, Human-Led: Arbeite an vorderster Front einer Organisation, die AI-nativ aufgebaut ist. Du nutzt AI, um deinen Impact zu vervielfachen – während Urteilsvermögen, Kreativität und Ownership klar menschlich bleiben.

  • Schnell lernen und wachsen: Kontinuierliches Feedback, 360°-Reviews und ein eigenes Development-Budget, um genau die Skills aufzubauen, die du brauchst. Arbeite eng mit einem erfahrenen Managament Team zusammen, die Richtung vorgeben – statt deinen Alltag im Detail zu steuern.

  • Leidenschaftliches Team: Werde Teil eines motivierten, unterstützenden Teams, das Klarheit, Ownership und echten Impact schätzt. In unseren Pods arbeitest du in engen, eingespielten Teams – mit echter Zusammenarbeit statt nur geteilten Tools.

  • Kultur & Zugehörigkeit: Inklusiv, divers und mit Spaß an der Sache – von virtuellen Team-Events bis zu unvergesslichen Offsites schaffen wir überall ein starkes Gemeinschaftsgefühl, inklusive regelmäßigem gemeinsamem Co-Working in Berlin und München.

  • Am Erfolg beteiligt sein: Über unser VSOP-Programm hast du direkten Anteil am Wachstum des Unternehmens

Klingt nach einem Match?

Dann lass uns sprechen.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Mareike Buzzoni (Head of People and Culture)

Auch wenn du dir nicht zu 100 % sicher bist, ob du alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Neugier, Begeisterung für digitale Innovation, Lernbereitschaft, Teamgeist und eine echte Growth-Mindset-Mentalität sind für uns am wichtigsten.

TradeLink ist fest davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt eine große Stärke ist, und setzt sich für ein respektvolles, sicheres und offenes Umfeld für alle ein, die bei oder mit uns arbeiten. Um unbewusste Vorurteile im Bewerbungsprozess zu reduzieren, kannst du dein Bewerbungsfoto gern weglassen.

Sales Development Representative (w/m/d)

DEINE ROLLE

Als Sales Development Representative bist du der erste Kontakt, den Gründer, Geschäftsführer und CFOs mittelständischer Unternehmen mit Skalar haben. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Account Executives ihre Zeit mit den richtigen Unternehmen verbringen: Du reagierst schnell auf eingehende Anfragen, qualifizierst sie gegen unser Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) und sprichst gezielt Unternehmen an, die zu uns passen.

Gemessen wirst du nicht an Anrufzahlen, sondern an qualifizierten Erstgesprächen, die unsere Account Executives annehmen und weiterführen. Du berichtest an unseren Teamlead Sales und arbeitest eng mit Growth, Marketing und den Account Executives zusammen. Was du in deinen Gesprächen über die Probleme unserer Zielgruppe lernst, fließt direkt in Positionierung, Kampagnen und unsere Sales-Tools zurück.

DEINE AUFGABE

INBOUND & QUALIFIZIERUNG

  • Schnelle Erstreaktion auf eingehende Anfragen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn

  • Strukturierte Qualifizierungsgespräche: Unternehmensgröße, Rechtsform, Buchhaltungs- und Steuer-Setup, Zeitpunkt und Entscheidungswege

  • Terminierung von Discovery Calls für unsere Account Executives inklusive Übergabe-Briefing, damit niemand dieselbe Frage zweimal stellt

OUTBOUND & ACCOUNT-RESEARCH

  • Recherche und Priorisierung von Zielunternehmen und Entscheidern

  • Personalisierte Multi-Channel-Ansprache über Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn, etc.

  • Testen und Auswerten von Sequenzen, Botschaften und Zielsegmenten

  • Eigenverantwortlicher Auf- und Ausbau unseres Outreach-Playbooks über alle Kanäle

CRM, DATEN & AUTOMATISIERUNG

  • Saubere Dokumentation und Pipeline-Hygiene in HubSpot

  • Eigenes Reporting zu Aktivitäten, Antwortquoten und Conversion vom Lead zum qualifizierten Termin

  • Arbeit mit KI-gestützten Sales-Tools für Recherche, Personalisierung und Gesprächsnotizen

  • Feedback an unsere Softwareentwickler: Du beschreibst, wo Zeit verloren geht, gemeinsam baut ihr die Lösung

WORAN WIR ERFOLG MESSEN

  • Anzahl qualifizierter Erstgespräche pro Monat, die von den Account Executives angenommen werden

Konkrete Zielwerte legen wir gemeinsam in deinen ersten Wochen fest und besprechen sie offen im Bewerbungsprozess.

DEINE ENTWICKLUNG

  • Strukturiertes Onboarding: Grundlagen der Unternehmensbesteuerung, unser ICP, Gesprächsleitfäden und Call-Shadowing bei den Account Executives

  • Regelmäßige Call-Reviews und 1:1s mit dem Account Executive und CSO

  • Klarer Entwicklungspfad zum Account Executive oder mit Fokus auf Outreach: Die Kriterien für den nächsten Schritt definieren wir beim Start gemeinsam und überprüfen sie in festen Abständen

WAS DU MITBRINGST

  • Erste Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise als SDR oder BDR in einem SaaS- oder Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Quereinsteiger mit nachweisbarem Vertriebstalent sind willkommen

  • Freude an Telefonaten und Kaltakquise: Du gehst auf Menschen zu und bleibst auch nach einem Nein freundlich und hartnäckig

  • Lust, das Thema Outreach zu ownen und „von 1 auf 100“ zu bringen

  • Den Anspruch, bis ins Detail zu verstehen, wie wir kalte Leads am besten ansprechen und konvertieren

  • Souveräne Kommunikation mit Gründern und Geschäftsführern, schriftlich wie mündlich

  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene Arbeitsweise: Du misst deine Aktivitäten und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab

  • Interesse an Steuern und Finanzen von Unternehmen. Vorwissen ist kein Muss, die Bereitschaft, es dir schnell anzueignen, schon

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise HubSpot, und Offenheit für neue Tools

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (zwingend für Mandantengespräche), fließendes Englisch (Unternehmenssprache)

  • Den Wunsch, dich weiterzuentwickeln, zum Account Executive oder mit Fokus auf Outreach

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • AI-natives Setup: KI ist fester Bestandteil unserer Vertriebsprozesse, von der Recherche bis zur Gesprächsnotiz

  • Das Tooling, das du brauchst: Was fehlt, beschaffen wir oder unsere Softwareentwickler bauen es mit dir

  • Raum zum Experimentieren: Du testest neue Kanäle, Tools und Ansätze und trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass daraus messbare Ergebnisse werden

  • Hoher Freiheitsgrad darin, wie du deine Ziele erreichst

  • Ownership für Outreach: Du verantwortest das Thema und treibst es eigenständig voran

WIR BAUEN DIE STEUERKANZLEI DER ZUKUNFT

Radikal einfach. Hochautomatisiert. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfach, schnell und transparent für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis: digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst. So bleibt Zeit für das, was zählt: Beratung, Sonderfälle und smarte Lösungen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen „Digitalkanzleien“: Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Deine Kollegen bauen die Tools, die dir im Vertriebsalltag helfen, für deine Probleme und nicht von der Stange.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.
